name: ugc-ad
description: Edited UGC ads with an on-camera creator, spoken prices, on-screen captions and cut-away product shots (e.g. Nineone Car Rental). Voice must finish before each transition; exact wording and prices are checked by a listen list.
visual_checklist: Voice finishes before every transition starts (about 0.2 s tail); no speech under a swipe or cover
Spoken lines match the approved script word for word, including small words; list every price, number, brand word and previously fixed line with timestamps for the owner to listen to

Prices and numbers are spoken as words in the natural spoken form of the audience (e.g. 1,950 is "nineteen fifty", not "one thousand nine hundred fifty"), with the unit after the number; one price per clip; the on-screen digits match
Coined or brand words are spoken as plain words (unlimited mileage); no mispronounced terms
No repeated words, restarts or stutters; a pause of 0.25 s or more inside one line is suspect
Captions are readable over the footage (solid pill, white text over similar colours), never overlapping the logo, face or each other
End card is clean through the last frame: no stray swipe, panel or half-faded element
Business facts (names, prices, phone number, contact lines) match the brief exactly; car details are never altered
The creator has the same face, hair and clothes as the reference photo in every clip
Cut-away product shots show the right product for the line being spoken
Hands, face and mouth look natural; no text, watermark or stray logo drawn into the footage
